newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil '97 debt servicing to hit $24 bln -report.
newsitem.headline: Brazil '97 debt servicing to hit $24 bln -report.

text.p: The Brazilian government will pay some 25.2 billion reais ($23.8 billion) in interest payments on its foreign and domestic debt in 1997, significantly more than it will spend on either health or education, Folha de Sao Paulo said Monday.
The paper said debt servicing would account for 12 percent of the 1997 federal budget, compared to 8.7 percent for health and 5.5 percent for education.
It said debt service has taken a large portion of the federal budget over the past several years, accounting for 11.2 percent of the budget in 1996 and 11.6 percent in 1995.
Brazil's total net public sector debt is about 280 billion reais, or $265 billion.
--John Miller, Sao Paulo newsroom, 5511 248-5414 ($ = 1.058 Brazilian Reais)
